main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (20-bar forward return minus coin's normal 20-bar drift), non-overlapping grid, coins pooled
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2.0 and timing gain > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2.0; at least 300 grid cases

supporting_check.name: book timing gain (mean daily book return minus gain from market's own rise)

decided_by: The main t lies between -2.0 and 2.0 (or its sign disagrees with the mean), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Every grid bar with a 20-bar forward return inside its window counts as a case, including flat (forecast 0) bars, and the coin's normal 20-bar drift is the mean of its grid forward returns over all windows; the plan's 'fewer than 300 grid cases' is treated as a minimum count, so it gives 'not observable'.
